blocks.html:
Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in the helmet store north of the longhall. In order to receive his vote, you must kill a special warrior called Koschei the Deathless. However, the fight has three rules:
You must defeat him at least three out of four times.
You must fight to the death.
You are not allowed to use weapons or armour or beasts of burden. This also means no runes, staves, etc (you can use food, prayer, rings of recoil, already summoned familiars, a pickaxe or hatchet removed from your tool belt, or even a dismantled godsword).
blocks.text: Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in the helmet store north of the longhall. In order to receive his vote, you must kill a special warrior called Koschei the Deathless. However, the fight has three rules:You must defeat him at least three out of four times.You must fight to the death.You are not allowed to use weapons or armour or beasts of burden. This also means no runes, staves, etc (you can use food, prayer, rings of recoil, already summoned familiars, a pickaxe or hatchet removed from your tool belt, or even a dismantled godsword).

blocks.html: Climb down the ladder and wait for him to appear to begin the fight.
blocks.text: Climb down the ladder and wait for him to appear to begin the fight.

blocks.html: Defeat him three times and either kill him the fourth time or let yourself be defeated. (You will not die).
